title: Vicor
summary: US maker of high-density power modules for data centres, satellites and defence.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Vicor builds power-conversion modules with high density and efficiency, used in AI data-centre boards, satellites and defence electronics. Its factorised power architecture lets customers distribute conversion close to the load, which matters as accelerator currents rise. The company is expanding into 48-volt data-centre power and space-qualified modules.

Technology Exposure

  • Power-conversion modules
  • 48-volt data-centre power
  • Space and defence power systems

What To Watch

  • AI server power-content growth
  • Design-win conversion
  • Manufacturing capacity

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
